description: Unit test class for testing the SubscriptionEventAdapter's ability to convert between SubscriptionEvent objects and Adaptable objects, as well as parsing Adaptables into specific SubscriptionEvent subtypes. It validates serialization/deserialization logic for subscription-related events in the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter environment.

classes.name: SubscriptionEventAdapterTest
classes.description: Unit test class for SubscriptionEventAdapter, testing conversion between SubscriptionEvent objects and Adaptable objects, including parsing and serialization of various subscription event types.
